meta.description: Read, write, and convert phylogenetic tree files with Biopython Bio.Phylo, and choose an annotation-preserving parser (treeio, DendroPy) when metadata matters.
meta.executed: 9/9 inputs executed (Biopython 1.88, DendroPy 5.0.13, ete3 3.1.3, rdflib 7.6.0, R treeio 1.30.0 / ape 5.8.1)
meta.execution_note: Re-audit of the fixed Skill: 7 pre-fix inputs as regression tests plus 2 new inputs (N = 9). Skill snippets verbatim (paths only). Windows locale cp1252. SYNTHETIC data (data/make_data.py).
